title: Final docs pass: tools, concepts, README status, design note status
description:
## Intent

Final docs pass for the initiative.

## Steps

- `docs/tools.md`: the export command complete (all flags), the server route, the examples smoke script.
- `docs/concepts.md` "Taking a score into a DAW": final; and the "Where it's going" list no longer lists anything this initiative built.
- README.md: the status line mentions DAW set export; the Layout table row for `crates/apricity-daw` (from M1) still correct.
- `design/daw-set.md`: status "built", open questions answered or moved to issues.
- Semantic Release writes CHANGELOG.md from the commits; no hand edits.

## Verification

The diff adds no mention of the vendor's name or the DAW's product name; `npm --prefix web run build` shows the pages in the Docs tab.

## Release

`docs(<this task's id>): DAW set export, complete`.
